objective: Add an optional planner-level process that annotates skills and tools with evidence-backed reasoning taxonomy, purpose, dependencies, licenses, uncertainty, and independent review.
invariants: to_prism/taxonomy.json remains the sole canonical component taxonomy
generative, deterministic, and hybrid are derived postures rather than replacement taxonomy classes
unsupported metadata is unknown or explicitly abstained rather than guessed
annotation never executes or mutates the target capability
license metadata is evidence inventory and compatibility triage, not legal advice
disabled mode preserves existing planner behavior, outputs, and digests

phases.name: semantics and authority boundary
phases.promotion_gate: canonical ownership, units, posture derivation, evidence precedence, and non-goals are frozen

phases.name: strict contracts and ports
phases.promotion_gate: skill and tool targets normalize without losing provenance and standalone planning needs no repository crawl

phases.name: planner skills and deterministic validators
phases.promotion_gate: the four planning skills produce strict draft packages and abstain safely

phases.name: critique, lifecycle, and optional integration
phases.promotion_gate: review, invalidation, extension, and default-off paths are enforced

phases.name: benchmarks and compatibility
phases.promotion_gate: forward and adversarial cases pass with zero disabled-mode regression

phases.name: documentation and controlled promotion
phases.promotion_gate: operator guidance, review ownership, rollback, and catalog projection policy are approved

todos.action: Freeze the annotation vocabulary, target kinds, units of annotation, statuses, non-goals, and distinction between authored, observed, derived, and inferred metadata.
acceptance: skill, tool, adapter, and external capability are covered
planned use cannot be labeled observed
unknown and not_applicable are distinct
todos.example: A documentation-only skill receives non_executing posture without an invented runtime.
todos.rollback: remove the unreferenced planning document

todos.action: Specify immutable binding to taxonomy ID, version, and SHA-256 digest, with to_prism/taxonomy.json as sole authority and no planner-owned fork.
acceptance: taxonomy drift invalidates an annotation
standalone fixtures are explicitly non-authoritative
planner code has no static to_prism import
todos.example: An annotation made against taxonomy 0.8.0 becomes stale when its digest changes.
todos.rollback: leave taxonomy annotation unavailable when no provider is configured

todos.action: Freeze canonical facet decision rules, evidence precedence, confidence, rationale, most-specific-taxon storage, and explicit abstention behavior.
acceptance: exactly one primary_family is required
facet cardinalities and ancestor rules match the bound taxonomy
unsupported facets are abstained
todos.example: Typed JSON input supports schema_constrained but does not prove deterministic execution.
todos.rollback: return needs_input instead of a partial taxonomy assertion

todos.action: Define deterministic, generative, hybrid, non_executing, and unresolved as derived operational postures with exact contributing facets and negative rules.
acceptance: posture never replaces canonical facets
mixed capabilities split into operations when possible
model or implementation names alone cannot determine posture
todos.example: A seeded symbolic candidate generator may be deterministic and generative in realization, so the derivation explains the chosen summary.
todos.rollback: emit unresolved posture while retaining supported facets

todos.action: Define typed dependency edges, phases, conditions, version evidence, availability, fallbacks, authority implications, and source-basis precedence.
acceptance: runtime, package, model, service, data, credential, network, hardware, and human-review dependencies are representable
required and optional dependencies differ
transitive unknowns remain visible
todos.example: A PubMed retrieval adapter records network and credential posture separately from its Python package dependency.
todos.rollback: retain unresolved dependency records without claiming invocability

todos.action: Define license and terms evidence for code, content, weights, data, APIs, adapters, and transitive dependencies, including scope and compatibility dispositions.
acceptance: SPDX is used only when supported
nearest nested license scope is respected
custom, conflicting, restrictive, and unknown terms cannot be silently promoted
todos.example: MIT repository code does not erase research-only terms on bundled model weights.
todos.rollback: mark promotion blocked while keeping the capability discoverable

todos.action: Version semantic, dependency, license, provenance, stale-evidence, and generated-metadata masking threats with required safe dispositions.
acceptance: each threat has a minimal fixture
unsafe inference maps to abstain, needs_input, blocked, or extension_required
no threat is resolved by schema validity alone
todos.example: A model-written description cannot be relabeled declared without reviewer evidence.
todos.rollback: keep rollout off until every P0 threat has a fixture

todos.action: Create strict CapabilityAnnotationRequest and CapabilityTarget schemas with stable identity, purpose, source boundary, revision, and digest.
acceptance: all target kinds normalize
aliases cannot replace stable IDs
missing source digest prevents review status
todos.example: A local SKILL.md and a remote callable tool share target fields while retaining kind-specific locators.
todos.rollback: reject annotation requests that cannot freeze target identity

todos.action: Create a field-addressable source-evidence schema with basis, exact anchor, digest, confidence, extraction time, reviewer state, and source precedence.
acceptance: every asserted field can trace to evidence
generated inference is distinguishable from documented and implementation-derived evidence
stale anchors fail validation
todos.example: The determinacy assertion points to the operative procedure, not the skill name.
todos.rollback: drop unsupported fields and emit abstentions

todos.action: Create a strict reasoning-taxonomy annotation schema containing taxonomy binding, operation identity, facets, evidence, confidence, rationale, abstentions, and derived posture receipt.
acceptance: facet assertions are field-evidenced
posture lists contributing facet paths
unknown taxa cannot pass as canonical
todos.example: A hybrid retriever/writer has separate operation annotations and an evidence-backed aggregate posture.
todos.rollback: retain a draft with extension_required or unresolved status

todos.action: Create a dependency-and-license manifest schema with typed graph edges, scoped license records, compatibility dispositions, provenance, and unresolved obligations.
acceptance: dependency cycles and missing targets are representable and detectable
each license record has a subject and scope
unknown never becomes permissive by default
todos.example: A callable tool links service terms, adapter code license, and client-library license without collapsing them.
todos.rollback: set compatibility to unresolved and block promotion

todos.action: Create review, package, invalidation, and taxonomy-extension-proposal schemas with explicit lifecycle transitions and reviewer separation.
acceptance: reviewed requires an independent critic receipt
extension proposals cannot mutate taxonomy
invalidation names changed digests and affected fields
todos.example: An unsupported reasoning taxon yields extension_required and remains non-promotable.
todos.rollback: limit lifecycle to draft and blocked until transition validation exists

todos.action: Add read-only ReasoningTaxonomyProvider and CapabilitySourceProvider ports plus in-memory implementations for standalone tests.
acceptance: no parent-directory discovery occurs
no static catalog or to_prism import is introduced
source bundles are digest verified
todos.example: A host injects taxonomy 0.8.0 as bytes and receives the same digest-bound result as a repository adapter.
todos.rollback: leave the annotation journey unavailable without configured providers

todos.action: Design bounded repository adapters for skill descriptors and external capability records without changing their authoritative loaders or schemas.
acceptance: adapters normalize source-specific fields into CapabilityTarget
existing descriptor builds are byte-stable when annotation is disabled
network and execution remain prohibited
todos.example: External record dependencies seed evidence but remain free-text source facts until normalized and reviewed.
todos.rollback: remove adapter registration while retaining in-memory planning

todos.action: Create capability-annotation-planner as the explicit router that freezes target and purpose, inventories sources, coordinates specialists, and returns statusful packages.
acceptance: ordinary planning does not invoke it
no target source is mutated
missing evidence yields named questions or blockers
todos.example: Annotate this new report-writing skill produces a draft package, not a rewritten skill.
todos.rollback: remove the unregistered skill directory

todos.action: Create reasoning-taxonomy-annotator with concise instructions and a referenced decision table for canonical facets, operation splitting, abstention, and posture derivation.
acceptance: instructions distinguish canonical facets from coarse posture
negative rules are applied
output validates against the bound taxonomy
todos.example: A criteria-guided narrative synthesis is not promoted to formal deduction.
todos.rollback: route taxonomy requests to needs_input

todos.action: Create capability-dependency-license-annotator with bounded evidence collection, typed dependencies, scoped terms, and uncertainty rules.
acceptance: no install, network, or arbitrary environment scan occurs
nested licenses and service terms remain distinct
transitive unknowns are surfaced
todos.example: A requirements file supplies package evidence but not proof of runtime observation.
todos.rollback: return an unresolved manifest and prohibit promotion

todos.action: Create capability-annotation-critic that independently reviews semantic leakage, evidence sufficiency, operation boundaries, hidden dependencies, and license scope.
acceptance: critic identity is distinct from annotator identity
each defect names field, evidence, severity, and remediation
hard contradictions prevent reviewed status
todos.example: The critic rejects deterministic because the remote provider and sampling behavior are unspecified.
todos.rollback: all packages remain review_required

todos.action: Implement pure validators for schema, taxonomy binding/cardinality/ancestor rules, evidence anchors, digest integrity, dependency graph, lifecycle transition, and coarse-posture consistency.
acceptance: validation has no I/O side effects
semantic confidence is not inferred from schema success
errors use stable machine-readable codes
todos.example: A child and its ancestor in the same facet fails with redundant_ancestor_taxon.
todos.rollback: disable package creation when validators are unavailable

todos.action: Implement a bounded source inventory that identifies declared manifests, referenced scripts, locks, model/data/service declarations, and nearest license files without executing content.
acceptance: only frozen bundle paths are read
symlink and traversal escapes are rejected
every discovered item has a digest and basis
todos.example: A nested LICENSE in a referenced subdirectory is reported with its actual scope.
todos.rollback: accept only explicitly supplied evidence bundles

todos.action: Run skill-creator validation and independent forward tests for all four planner skills, including trigger discrimination and context-size review.
acceptance: quick_validate passes for each skill
ordinary workflow planning does not falsely trigger annotation
complex examples are independently forward tested
todos.example: A request to use an existing tool is not mistaken for a request to annotate it.
todos.rollback: keep skills undiscoverable until trigger tests pass

todos.action: Add an explicit default-off capability-annotation profile with draft, needs_input, extension_required, blocked, review_required, reviewed, stale, and superseded states.
acceptance: only explicit annotation intent enters the profile
invalid transitions are rejected
reviewed requires critic and digest gates
todos.example: Taxonomy drift moves reviewed to stale, never directly back to reviewed.
todos.rollback: unregister the profile and leave current lifecycle unchanged

todos.action: Implement field-level invalidation for target, taxonomy, dependency manifest, license evidence, model/provider revision, and reviewed override changes.
acceptance: changed inputs identify affected assertions
revalidation never silently refreshes evidence
unaffected fields may be retained with provenance
todos.example: A package-lock change invalidates dependency and license conclusions but not an unchanged purpose description.
todos.rollback: invalidate the whole package conservatively

todos.action: Register the explicit journey without modifying direct-use precedence or existing new, extend, refine, trust, and economics outputs.
acceptance: feature flag defaults off
existing request fixtures retain byte-stable outputs when off
annotation cannot execute a capability
todos.example: Plan a workflow follows the old route; annotate this workflow's skills enters the new route only when enabled.
todos.rollback: set rollout state off and remove route registration

todos.action: Specify a separately authorized reviewed-overlay projection into skill descriptors and external capability views without changing prose authority or overloading the authority field.
acceptance: digest-bound sidecars live outside target packages to avoid self-referential digests
draft annotations never enter canonical indexes
field-level provenance survives projection
existing schema consumers can ignore the additive view
todos.example: Derived hybrid posture appears in an annotation view, not in skill authority=deterministic.
todos.rollback: retain packages as planner artifacts only

todos.action: Define taxonomy extension review requiring corpus examples, exclusions, overlap analysis, migration impact, version change, and independent approval.
acceptance: the planner cannot create canonical taxa
extension proposals include positive and negative examples
promotion waits for a new bound taxonomy version
todos.example: A novel reasoning mode remains extension_required until taxonomy maintainers approve it.
todos.rollback: map no extension and preserve abstention

todos.action: Create reviewed forward fixtures for deterministic, generative, hybrid, non-executing, external-service, and operation-split capabilities with expected evidence and abstentions.
acceptance: both skills and tools are represented
oracles bind source and taxonomy digests
reviewer disagreement is recorded rather than erased
todos.example: A retrieval-plus-synthesis tool is correctly split instead of receiving an unexplained mixed label.
todos.rollback: keep results diagnostic and rollout off

todos.action: Implement all threat fixtures for false determinism/generation, retrieval leakage, license inheritance, hidden dependencies, cycles, aliases, generated metadata, stale digests, and unknown taxa.
acceptance: every threat has a required safe disposition
hard cases cannot reach reviewed
false-completeness rate is reported separately from coverage
todos.example: A temperature-zero remote LLM remains unknown or underdetermined without a complete provider contract.
todos.rollback: block advisory rollout on any hard-case escape

todos.action: Add schema, validator, digest, graph, lifecycle, invalidation, source-boundary, and field-provenance test suites.
acceptance: strict additionalProperties rules are tested
traversal and stale evidence fail closed
unknown and abstention round-trip exactly
todos.example: A dependency edge missing evidence_basis fails validation.
todos.rollback: do not package the profile until contract tests pass

todos.action: Verify the standalone wheel and assert disabled-mode equivalence across planner contracts, profiles, indexes, routes, hooks, and generated digests.
acceptance: wheel works outside the checkout
no static catalog or to_prism import exists
existing fixtures are unchanged with rollout off
todos.example: A host without taxonomy provider can still perform every pre-existing planning journey.
todos.rollback: remove packaged annotation resources and keep rollout off

todos.action: Run blinded dual-review on a held-out mixed corpus and measure facet agreement, abstention quality, false completeness, posture accuracy, and license/dependency omission severity.
acceptance: promotion thresholds are frozen before evaluation
false reviewed classifications are zero for hard blockers
disagreements produce calibration actions
todos.example: Reviewer disagreement over evidential versus model-based reasoning remains a recorded adjudication case.
todos.rollback: retain diagnostic-only status

todos.action: Document invocation, interpretation, abstention, review, legal boundary, source preparation, invalidation, and rollback with concrete skill and tool examples.
acceptance: users can distinguish facets from derived posture
license results are not framed as legal advice
default-off state is prominent
todos.example: The guide shows why an LLM tool can be schema-constrained but underdetermined.
todos.rollback: remove links to an unavailable journey

todos.action: Define off, shadow, diagnostic, advisory, and reviewed-projection rollout states with named owners, metrics, incident response, and one-step rollback.
acceptance: promotion is evidence-based and reversible
annotation cannot become an invocation authorization
reviewed projection requires separate explicit approval
todos.example: Shadow mode records comparison artifacts but changes no catalog or route decisions.
todos.rollback: set effective rollout state to off

todos.action: After authorized implementation, replace planned statuses only with evidence-backed completion records including test counts, digests, unresolved calibration, and effective rollout state.
acceptance: no TODO is marked complete from code presence alone
unresolved external review remains explicit
receipt identifies exact rollback target
todos.example: Software-complete but review-study-incomplete remains diagnostic rather than advisory.
todos.rollback: restore status planned or blocked with the missing evidence named

definition_of_done: four planner skills and all strict contracts pass forward and adversarial tests
skill and tool targets normalize without losing source-specific provenance
canonical facets, derived posture, dependencies, and licenses remain separate evidence-backed views
review and invalidation prevent stale or incomplete annotations from promotion
standalone and disabled-mode compatibility are demonstrated
catalog projection remains separately authorized and reversible
